---
title: "Chingaza plant microbiomes manuscript analyses"
author: "Daniela Betancurt-Anzola"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    code_folding: show
params:
  data_root: "."
  output_dir: "paper_output"
  refit_ancom: false
---

The current manuscript figures are rebuilt from frozen counts and classifications. Archive sequence-processing chunks have `eval=FALSE`. Set `refit_ancom: true` to refit the nine exploratory contrasts.

```{r setup}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
required <- c("phyloseq", "qiime2R", "dplyr", "tidyr", "tibble", "readr", "ggplot2",
              "vegan", "permute", "ggrepel", "scales", "patchwork", "pheatmap", "RColorBrewer")
if (isTRUE(params$refit_ancom)) required <- c(required, "ANCOMBC")
missing <- required[!vapply(required, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]
if (length(missing)) stop("Install required packages: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(phyloseq); library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(tibble); library(ggplot2)
})
manifest <- read.csv("Paper_repository_files.csv", check.names = FALSE)
paper_input <- function(key) {
  i <- match(key, manifest$Key)
  if (is.na(i)) stop("Unknown input key: ", key)
  repo <- file.path(params$data_root, manifest$Repo_path[i])
  path <- if (file.exists(repo)) repo else manifest$Local_source[i]
  if (!file.exists(path)) stop("Missing input ", key, ": ", repo)
  normalizePath(path)
}
paper_out <- path.expand(params$output_dir)
dir.create(paper_out, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
paper_out <- normalizePath(paper_out)
section_out <- function(name) {
  path <- file.path(paper_out, name)
  dir.create(path, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  path
}
set.seed(20260924)
```

## Illumina phylum profiles and dbRDA

The phylum plots and dbRDA retain the filtering and transformations. dbRDA uses unrarefied counts. Its axis percentages describe constrained variation. PERMANOVA uses rarefied counts and unrestricted permutations.

```{r illumina-figures, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
paper_illumina <- local({
  suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(phyloseq)
    library(qiime2R)
    library(dplyr)
    library(tibble)
    library(ggplot2)
    library(vegan)
    library(ggrepel)
  })
  compartment_pal <- c(Bulk_Soil = "#8B4513", Rhizosphere = "#FFD700",
                       Endosphere = "#228B22", Aboveground = "#87CEEB")
  fungal_soil_pal <- c(Ascomycota = "#E69F00", Basidiomycota = "#56B4E9",
    Blastocladiomycota = "#808000", Glomeromycota = "#A6192E",
    Mortierellomycota = "#009E73", Mucoromycota = "#D55E00",
    Chytridiomycota = "#8E63B0", Rozellomycota = "#8FBC8F",
    Entorrhizomycota = "#A6761D", Monoblepharomycota = "#C070B1",
    Kickxellomycota = "#7FBC41", Neocallimastigomycota = "#B38642",
    Fungi_phy_Incertae_sedis = "#999999", Zoopagomycota = "#9C755F",
    Other = "#444444")
  part_order <- c("BR", "BS", "Rh", "SP", "root", "stolon", "BG", "AG", "leaf")
  part_labels <- c(BR = "Soil with roots", BS = "Soil without roots",
    Rh = "Rhizosphere", SP = "Stolonosphere", root = "Root endosphere",
    stolon = "Stolon endosphere", BG = "Belowground endosphere",
    AG = "Aboveground endosphere", leaf = "Leaf endosphere")
  models <- list()
  soil_plots <- list()
  qc <- list()
  for (marker in c("16S", "ITS")) {
    prefix <- if (marker == "16S") "s16" else "its"
    load_ps <- function(meta_key) qiime2R::qza_to_phyloseq(
      features = paper_input(paste0(prefix, "_table")),
      taxonomy = paper_input(paste0(prefix, "_taxonomy")),
      metadata = paper_input(paste0(prefix, "_", meta_key)))
    ps <- load_ps("meta")
    ps_all <- load_ps("meta_all")
    filter_taxa <- function(x) {
      if (marker == "16S") {
        x <- subset_taxa(x, !grepl("chloroplast", Order, ignore.case = TRUE) | is.na(Order))
        x <- subset_taxa(x, !grepl("mitochondria", Family, ignore.case = TRUE) | is.na(Family))
        subset_taxa(x, !is.na(Kingdom) & Kingdom != "" &
                      !grepl("Unassigned", Kingdom, ignore.case = TRUE))
      } else {
        subset_taxa(x, !is.na(Kingdom) & grepl("Fungi", Kingdom, ignore.case = TRUE))
      }
    }
    ps <- filter_taxa(ps)
    ps_all <- filter_taxa(ps_all)
    ps <- prune_samples(sample_sums(ps) >= if (marker == "16S") 10000 else 15000, ps)
    # The original 16S fine-part bars retain all samples after taxon filtering.
    if (marker == "ITS") ps_all <- prune_samples(sample_sums(ps_all) >= 15000, ps_all)
    qc[[marker]] <- data.frame(Marker = marker, Sample = sample_names(ps_all),
      Retained_reads = unname(sample_sums(ps_all)),
      Used_in_dbRDA = sample_names(ps_all) %in% sample_names(ps))
    phy <- transform_sample_counts(tax_glom(ps, "Phylum"), function(x) x / sum(x) * 100)
    top <- psmelt(phy) %>% group_by(Phylum) %>%
      summarise(Total = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>% arrange(desc(Total)) %>%
      slice_head(n = if (marker == "16S") 10 else 8) %>% pull(Phylum)
    palette <- setNames(c(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(length(top),
      if (marker == "16S") "Paired" else "Set2"),
      if (marker == "16S") "grey70" else "black"), c(sort(top), "Other"))
    fine <- transform_sample_counts(tax_glom(ps_all, "Phylum"), function(x) x / sum(x) * 100)
    df <- psmelt(fine) %>% mutate(
      Phylum_grouped = factor(ifelse(Phylum %in% top, Phylum, "Other"),
                              levels = c(sort(top), "Other")),
      Part = factor(Shortened_description, levels = part_order))
    df <- df %>% group_by(Sample, Host_species, Part, Phylum_grouped) %>%
      summarise(Abundance = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
      arrange(Host_species, Part, Sample)
    df$Sample <- factor(df$Sample, levels = unique(as.character(df$Sample)))
    write.csv(df, file.path(paper_out, paste0(marker, "_phylum_plot_data.csv")), row.names = FALSE)
    bar_plot <- function(d, colors) {
      ggplot(d, aes(Sample, Abundance, fill = Phylum_grouped)) +
        geom_col(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.1) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = colors, name = paste(marker, "Phylum")) +
        scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0)) +
        coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 100)) +
        labs(x = NULL, y = "Relative abundance (%)") + theme_minimal() +
        theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom")
    }
    for (host in unique(df$Host_species)) {
      p <- bar_plot(df[df$Host_species == host, ], palette) +
        facet_grid(. ~ Part, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x",
                   labeller = as_labeller(part_labels)) + labs(title = host)
      ggsave(file.path(paper_out, paste0(marker, "_phylum_", host, ".pdf")),
             p, width = 11, height = 5, useDingbats = FALSE)
    }
    all_parts <- bar_plot(df, palette) + facet_grid(. ~ Host_species + Part,
      scales = "free_x", space = "free_x", labeller = label_wrap_gen(10))
    ggsave(file.path(paper_out, paste0(marker, "_phylum_all_hosts.pdf")),
           all_parts, width = 16, height = 6, useDingbats = FALSE)
    soil <- df[df$Part %in% c("BR", "BS"), ]
    soil_colors <- if (marker == "ITS") fungal_soil_pal else palette
    stopifnot(all(unique(as.character(soil$Phylum_grouped)) %in% names(soil_colors)))
    soil_lookup <- distinct(soil, Sample, Part)
    soil_labels <- setNames(ifelse(soil_lookup$Part == "BR", "Soil with roots", "Soil without roots"), as.character(soil_lookup$Sample))
    soil_plots[[marker]] <- bar_plot(soil, soil_colors) +
      scale_x_discrete(labels = soil_labels) +
      guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 3)) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = .5, size = 7)) +
      facet_grid(. ~ Host_species, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") + labs(title = marker)
    ggsave(file.path(paper_out, paste0(marker, "_phylum_soil_only.pdf")),
           soil_plots[[marker]], width = 12, height = 6, useDingbats = FALSE)
    bray <- phyloseq::distance(ps, "bray")
    meta <- as(sample_data(ps), "data.frame")
    cap <- vegan::capscale(bray ~ Broad_Compartment + Host_species, data = meta)
    sites <- cbind(as.data.frame(vegan::scores(cap, display = "sites")), meta)
    bp <- as.data.frame(vegan::scores(cap, display = "bp"))
    bp$Label <- rownames(bp)
    axis_pct <- 100 * cap$CCA$eig[1:2] / sum(cap$CCA$eig)
    p_cap <- ggplot(sites, aes(CAP1, CAP2)) +
      geom_point(aes(color = Broad_Compartment, shape = Host_species), size = 3, alpha = .8) +
      scale_color_manual(values = compartment_pal) +
      geom_segment(data = bp, inherit.aes = FALSE,
        aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = CAP1 * .9, yend = CAP2 * .9),
        arrow = arrow(length = grid::unit(.2, "cm")), colour = "black") +
      ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = bp, inherit.aes = FALSE,
        aes(CAP1 * .95, CAP2 * .95, label = Label), size = 3) +
      labs(title = paste(marker, "dbRDA"),
        x = sprintf("CAP1 (%.1f%% constrained variation)", axis_pct[1]),
        y = sprintf("CAP2 (%.1f%% constrained variation)", axis_pct[2])) +
      theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
    ggsave(file.path(paper_out, paste0(marker, "_dbRDA.pdf")), p_cap,
           width = 10, height = 8, useDingbats = FALSE)
    set.seed(20261123)
    a <- as.data.frame(anova(cap, by = "terms", permutations = 999))
    a$Term <- rownames(a)
    a$Raw_p_value <- a$`Pr(>F)`
    a$BH_adjusted_p_value <- NA_real_
    tested <- !is.na(a$Raw_p_value)
    a$BH_adjusted_p_value[tested] <- p.adjust(a$Raw_p_value[tested], "BH")
    a$Adjustment_family <- paste(marker, "two sequential dbRDA terms")
    write.csv(a, file.path(paper_out, paste0(marker, "_dbRDA_terms.csv")), row.names = FALSE)
    write.csv(data.frame(Marker = marker,
      Constrained_fraction = cap$CCA$tot.chi / cap$tot.chi,
      Adjusted_R2 = vegan::RsquareAdj(cap)$adj.r.squared,
      Axis1_percent_constrained = axis_pct[1], Axis2_percent_constrained = axis_pct[2],
      N_samples = nsamples(ps)), file.path(paper_out, paste0(marker, "_dbRDA_summary.csv")), row.names = FALSE)
    # Retain the source PERMANOVA rarefaction and model definitions.
    set.seed(42)
    rare <- rarefy_even_depth(ps, sample.size = min(sample_sums(ps)), rngseed = 42,
                             replace = FALSE, verbose = FALSE)
    rare_bray <- phyloseq::distance(rare, "bray")
    rare_meta <- as(sample_data(rare), "data.frame")
    set.seed(20261123)
    perm_models <- list(
      compartment = vegan::adonis2(rare_bray ~ Broad_Compartment, data = rare_meta, permutations = 999),
      host = vegan::adonis2(rare_bray ~ Host_species, data = rare_meta, permutations = 999),
      interaction = vegan::adonis2(rare_bray ~ Broad_Compartment * Host_species,
        data = rare_meta, permutations = 999, by = "terms"))
    tests <- bind_rows(lapply(names(perm_models), function(nm) {
      z <- as.data.frame(perm_models[[nm]])
      z$Term <- rownames(z)
      z$Model <- nm
      z
    }))
    tests$Raw_p_value <- tests$`Pr(>F)`
    tests$BH_adjusted_p_value <- NA_real_
    standalone <- tests$Model %in% c("compartment", "host") & tests$Term == "Model"
    tests$BH_adjusted_p_value[standalone] <- p.adjust(tests$Raw_p_value[standalone], "BH")
    interaction <- tests$Model == "interaction" & !is.na(tests$Raw_p_value)
    tests$BH_adjusted_p_value[interaction] <- p.adjust(tests$Raw_p_value[interaction], "BH")
    tests$Adjustment_family <- ifelse(tests$Model == "interaction",
      paste(marker, "sequential interaction-model terms"), paste(marker, "two standalone main-effect tests"))
    tests$Permutation_design <- "Unrestricted exploratory source analysis"
    tests$Rarefaction_depth <- min(sample_sums(rare))
    write.csv(tests, file.path(paper_out, paste0(marker, "_PERMANOVA_source_models.csv")), row.names = FALSE)
    print(p_cap)
    models[[marker]] <- list(ps = ps, ps_all = ps_all, dbRDA = cap,
      phylum = df, soil_plot = soil_plots[[marker]])
  }
  write.csv(bind_rows(qc), file.path(paper_out, "Illumina_sample_QC.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  models
})
```
# LSU phylum composition

```{r lsu-phylum, fig.width=14, fig.height=6}
paper_lsu <- local({
saved_plot_file <- paper_input("lsu_phylum")
plot_dir <- section_out("LSU_phylum")
out_path <- plot_dir
dir.create(file.path(out_path, "figures"), showWarnings = FALSE)
group_long <- readr::read_tsv(saved_plot_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
required_plot_columns <- c(
  "SampleID_join", "Host_species", "Compartment", "Plant_replicate",
  "Total_LSU_reads", "V18_AMF_reads", "V18_AMF_fraction",
  "Fungal_group", "Reads", "Relative_abundance"
)
if (!all(required_plot_columns %in% names(group_long))) {
  stop("Saved plot table is missing required columns: ",
       paste(setdiff(required_plot_columns, names(group_long)), collapse = ", "))
}
if (anyNA(group_long[, required_plot_columns]) ||
    anyDuplicated(group_long[, c("SampleID_join", "Fungal_group")]) ||
    any(group_long$Reads < 0) || any(group_long$Total_LSU_reads <= 0)) {
  stop("Saved plot table contains missing, duplicated, or invalid read data.")
}

sample_check <- group_long %>%
  group_by(SampleID_join) %>%
  summarise(
    across(c(Host_species, Compartment, Plant_replicate,
             Total_LSU_reads, V18_AMF_reads, V18_AMF_fraction), n_distinct),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
if (any(as.matrix(sample_check[, -1]) != 1)) {
  stop("Saved plot table has inconsistent metadata within a sample.")
}

sample_depth <- group_long %>%
  distinct(SampleID_join, Host_species, Compartment, Plant_replicate,
           Total_LSU_reads, V18_AMF_reads, V18_AMF_fraction) %>%
  mutate(Compartment = factor(
    Compartment,
    levels = c("BR", "BS", "SP", "Rh", "root", "stolon", "BG", "AG", "leaf")
  )) %>%
  arrange(Host_species, Compartment,
          suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Plant_replicate)),
          Plant_replicate, SampleID_join)

part_names <- c(BR = "BR", BS = "BS", SP = "SP", Rh = "Rhizosphere",
                root = "Root endosphere", stolon = "Stolon",
                BG = "BG", AG = "AG", leaf = "Leaf endosphere")

sample_totals <- group_long %>%
  group_by(SampleID_join) %>%
  summarise(Reads = sum(Reads), Share = sum(Relative_abundance),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(sample_depth %>% select(SampleID_join, Total_LSU_reads),
            by = "SampleID_join")
if (anyNA(sample_depth$Compartment) ||
    any(sample_totals$Reads != sample_totals$Total_LSU_reads) ||
    any(abs(sample_totals$Share - 1) > 1e-10)) {
  stop("Saved plot table does not reconcile to 100% for every sample.")
}

group_long <- group_long %>%
  mutate(Compartment = factor(
    Compartment,
    levels = levels(sample_depth$Compartment)
  ))
cat(nrow(sample_depth), "samples;", sum(sample_depth$Total_LSU_reads),
    "saved LSU reads. No taxonomy or count table was recomputed.\n")
group_colors <- c(
  "Ascomycota" = "#E69F00",
  "Basidiomycota" = "#56B4E9",
  "Blastocladiomycota" = "#808000",
  "Glomeromycota" = "#A6192E",
  "Mortierellomycota" = "#009E73",
  "Mucoromycota" = "#D55E00",
  "Chytridiomycota" = "#8E63B0",
  "Rozellomycota" = "#8FBC8F",
  "Entorrhizomycota" = "#A6761D",
  "Monoblepharomycota" = "#C070B1",
  "Sanchytriomycota" = "#DBB400",
  "Kickxellomycota" = "#7FBC41",
  "Neocallimastigomycota" = "#B38642",
  "Aphelidiomycota" = "#4DBBD5",
  "Mirabilomycota" = "#E78AC3",
  "Fungi; phylum unresolved" = "#999999",
  "V18 placement pending" = "#B0B0B0",
  "No EUKARYOME result" = "#C9C9C9",
  "Unclassified by EUKARYOME" = "#D9D9D9",
  "Other EUKARYOME kingdom" = "#444444"
)
if (!all(unique(group_long$Fungal_group) %in% names(group_colors))) {
  stop("A new fungal-group label needs an explicit plot color.")
}
group_long$Fungal_group <- factor(group_long$Fungal_group,
                                  levels = names(group_colors))
used_group_names <- names(group_colors)[names(group_colors) %in%
                                         unique(as.character(group_long$Fungal_group))]

plot_host <- function(host) {
  host_depth <- sample_depth %>%
    filter(Host_species == host) %>%
    mutate(Sample_x = factor(SampleID_join, levels = SampleID_join),
           AMF_label = scales::percent(V18_AMF_fraction, accuracy = 0.01))
  host_long <- group_long %>%
    filter(Host_species == host) %>%
    mutate(Sample_x = factor(SampleID_join, levels = levels(host_depth$Sample_x)))
  rep_labels <- setNames(paste0("R", host_depth$Plant_replicate),
                         host_depth$SampleID_join)

  ggplot(host_long %>% filter(Reads > 0),
         aes(x = Sample_x, y = Relative_abundance, fill = Fungal_group)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.86, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.12) +
    geom_text(data = host_depth, inherit.aes = FALSE,
              aes(x = Sample_x, y = 1.025, label = AMF_label), size = 2.65) +
    facet_grid(. ~ Compartment, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x",
               labeller = as_labeller(part_names)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors, breaks = used_group_names,
                      drop = FALSE, name = "Fungal phylum / unresolved") +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE)) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) unname(rep_labels[x])) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25),
                       labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1.09), clip = "off") +
    labs(
      title = paste("LSU -", host),
      x = "Independent biological sample (replicate)",
      y = "Share of all non-chimeric LSU reads",
      caption = paste(
        "Numbers above bars = V18-validated AMF share of all LSU reads.",
        "Glomeromycota uses V18 placement where validated; other phyla use EUKARYOME LSU v2.1."
      )
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
}

for (host in sort(unique(sample_depth$Host_species))) {
  n_parts <- n_distinct(sample_depth$Compartment[sample_depth$Host_species == host])
  width <- max(11, 6.4 + 1.2 * n_parts)
  file <- file.path(plot_dir,
                    paste0("LSU_all_reads_reconciled_relative_abundance_", host, ".pdf"))
  ggsave(file, plot_host(host), width = width, height = 5.2,
         units = "in", device = grDevices::pdf, useDingbats = FALSE)
  if (!file.exists(file) || file.info(file)$size == 0) stop("PDF export failed: ", file)
  cat("Wrote:", file, "\n")
}
soil_hosts <- c("Chusquea", "Espeletia", "Oritrophium", "Racomitrium")
soil_depth <- sample_depth %>%
  filter(Host_species %in% soil_hosts,
         as.character(Compartment) %in% c("BR", "BS")) %>%
  mutate(
    Host_species = factor(Host_species, levels = soil_hosts),
    Compartment = factor(as.character(Compartment), levels = c("BR", "BS"))
  ) %>%
  arrange(Host_species, Compartment,
          suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Plant_replicate)),
          Plant_replicate, SampleID_join)

soil_cells <- table(soil_depth$Host_species, soil_depth$Compartment)
if (any(soil_cells == 0)) {
  stop("A host is missing BR or BS samples in the LSU soil-only figure.")
}

soil_depth <- soil_depth %>%
  mutate(Sample_x = factor(SampleID_join, levels = SampleID_join))
soil_long <- group_long %>%
  filter(SampleID_join %in% soil_depth$SampleID_join) %>%
  mutate(
    Host_species = factor(Host_species, levels = soil_hosts),
    Sample_x = factor(SampleID_join, levels = levels(soil_depth$Sample_x))
  )

soil_bar_sums <- soil_long %>%
  group_by(SampleID_join) %>%
  summarise(Share = sum(Relative_abundance), .groups = "drop")
if (nrow(soil_bar_sums) != nrow(soil_depth) ||
    any(abs(soil_bar_sums$Share - 1) > 1e-10)) {
  stop("The LSU soil-only bars do not each sum to 100% of all LSU reads.")
}

soil_labels <- setNames(
  paste0(ifelse(soil_depth$Compartment == "BR", "Soil with roots",
                "Soil without roots"), "\nR", soil_depth$Plant_replicate),
  soil_depth$SampleID_join
)
used_soil_groups <- names(group_colors)[names(group_colors) %in%
                                         unique(as.character(soil_long$Fungal_group))]

p_soil_br_bs <- ggplot(soil_long %>% filter(Reads > 0),
                       aes(x = Sample_x, y = Relative_abundance,
                           fill = Fungal_group)) +
  geom_col(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.1) +
  facet_grid(. ~ Host_species, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors, breaks = used_soil_groups,
                    drop = TRUE, name = "LSU phylum / unresolved") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 4, byrow = TRUE)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) unname(soil_labels[x])) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25),
                     labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "LSU fungal phyla in soil with and without roots",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Relative abundance of all non-chimeric LSU reads",
    caption = paste(
      "BR and BS are independent biological samples, not paired subsamples.",
      "V18 validates AMF; EUKARYOME supplies other fungal phyla.",
      "Unresolved reads remain in the denominator."
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 7),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 7, hjust = 0)
  )

soil_plot_file <- Sys.getenv("LSU_SOIL_PDF", unset = "")
if (!nzchar(soil_plot_file)) {
  soil_plot_file <- file.path(out_path, "figures",
                              "LSU_all_reads_reconciled_soil_BR_BS_phylum.pdf")
}
ggsave(soil_plot_file, p_soil_br_bs, width = 14, height = 6.2,
       units = "in", device = grDevices::pdf, useDingbats = FALSE)
if (!file.exists(soil_plot_file) || file.info(soil_plot_file)$size == 0) {
  stop("PDF export failed: ", soil_plot_file)
}
cat("Wrote:", soil_plot_file, "\n")
list(soil_plot = p_soil_br_bs)
})
```
